svg.aria-label: Diagram: twelve confirmed-absent datasets in three groups
svg.title: Twelve confirmed-absent datasets
svg.text: Twelve datasets confirmed absent (GA-001 to GA-012)
Annual conviction rates by tribunal/district · FIR registration · 90-day compliance · withdrawal / abandonment · pre/post-2020 comparison.
National §17 prosecution counts · Witness Protection Bill (drafted, pending since 2015, not enacted) · marital rape exemption (CEDAW required removal 2016, still in force 2026).
DNA times by district/case type · district convictions · disposal-vs-conviction breakdowns · §32 hospital-refusal tracking.
